notes: Native firmware 0.1.6 — SAFETY: a TFT update is REFUSED when the panel's display is not responding (the delivery wedged the panel and dropped it off the network). Retry the Send after the display answers.

bug_fixes: The physical button modes are IMPLEMENTED on the panel — previously every press toggled the relay regardless of the configured mode.
DETACHED/FOLLOW presses are reported to the manager; CUSTOM_MQTT publishes the configured topic/payload.
The button configuration is delivered by the manager (set_button_config) — the old JSON config was never consumed by the firmware.
